title: University of Copenhagen Breach Exposes 525,000 Records
excerpt: A data breach at the University of Copenhagen has exposed the personal information of 525,000 individuals following unauthorized access.
body_html:
The University of Copenhagen in Denmark has confirmed a security incident involving unauthorized access to one of its test environments. According to the institution, the compromised system contained personal data belonging to 525,000 individuals.

The breach affects a substantial number of records stored within the test setup. Authorities and the university are managing the situation as investigations into the unauthorized access continue.
